metadata.boundary: Exclusive disposable non-production runtime surface for T004 managed NixOS build/activation and independent closure readback. T004 consumes only the separately leased immutable artifact.heim-pc.nixos-activation-source produced by T006; it does not materialize source from, read, or require authority over /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git or the mutable Heim-PC checkout. Nix evaluation/build consumes the artifact manifest-bound Git commit/tree, content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity, and the sandbox remains isolated from productive Heim-PC runtime, storage, EFI, firmware and persistent boot state.
